title: Claim verdict
description: Output of the claim-verify gate (scripts/verify-claims.py aggregate): every factual claim an agent artifact (spec, release findings) makes about the product, checked against canonical sources by a deterministic pre-pass and a fresh-context claim-verifier. Overall verdict: a material contradiction blocks (spec PR -> draft + label; finding excluded from ticket drafting); an immaterial contradiction (material: false) or any unverified claim flags; verified passes. Persisted at state/releases/<tag>/claim-verdict.json for release findings.

artifact_ref.description: Spec path in internal-docs, or the release tag

sources.description: Which canonical sources were available this run, with content hashes / checkout refs for reproducibility

id.description: d-NN = deterministic pre-pass claim; m-NN = model-enumerated claim

location.description: L<line> in a spec; evidence[i] or line within a finding's text

material.description: Contradicted claims only (null otherwise). false = the model judged the contradiction a measurement off by a little (line count, line number, size) with the artifact's argument intact at the corrected value; listed for a follow-up fix, does not block. Deterministic contradictions are always true.

source.description: Which canonical source or checkout path decided it

finding_pr.description: Release findings only: the pr_number of the finding the claim belongs to
